_about: RQ2 baseline task suite over the seeded IGR- families.
Ground truth mirrors env/manifests/. Each task states what a correct answer
contains, and what a wrong-but-plausible answer would contain, so the scorer can
tell a right answer from the specific failure the task is designed to provoke.
`gated` marks tasks whose answer is not in the first observation.
_environment: 2026-09-13: authoring notes removed from the four product descriptions. Before this, the notes stating each trap and two answers were on the page. See README decision log.

tasks.note: Control. The from-price is on the card, so one observation should suffice.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-water-a.html what price is shown for this product on first load? Report the exact price.

tasks.note: The headline example. Requires selecting the 2 x 9.5L variant.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-water-a.html what is the price of the 2 x 9.5L pack? Report the exact price.
On {base}/igr-water-b.html what is the price of the 2 x 9.5L pack? Report the exact price.

tasks.note: Needs every variant price, not one. Cheapest per litre is the largest pack.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-water-a.html which pack size is cheapest per litre? Name the pack size and its price.

tasks.note: The money task. Reproduces the deployed-assistant failure: the listing with the lower headline price is not the cheaper one for this size.
tasks.query: Two sellers list Glenmoor Still Spring Water: {base}/igr-water-a.html (Cellar Direct) and {base}/igr-water-b.html (Hillside Provisions). Which seller is cheaper for the 2 x 9.5L pack, and what is that price?
On {base}/igr-coffee-a.html what is the price of the 1 kg size? Report the exact price.

tasks.note: Breaks the bigger-is-cheaper heuristic. Best per kg is the middle size.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-coffee-a.html which size is the best value per kilogram? Name the size.
On {base}/igr-coffee-a.html is the 1 kg size the cheapest per kilogram? Answer yes or no and give the per-kilogram prices.

tasks.note: Parent reads In Stock. Size M is not.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-tee-a.html is size M available to buy? Answer yes or no.
On {base}/igr-tee-a.html what is the price of size XL? Report the exact price.
On {base}/igr-tee-a.html is every size currently in stock? Answer yes or no, and name any size that is not.
tasks.note: Same stock gating as tee-m-stock, asked without naming M, so the agent has to enumerate rather than check one option.
Exhaustive retrieval. Upper bound on interactions for one listing.
tasks.query: On {base}/igr-water-a.html list every pack size and its price.
